status: Proposed process network; no implemented runtime is implied

nodes.label: Choose the session task
nodes.guard: Name whose effort is saved and when
nodes.failure: Return to observation if no costly task is observed
nodes.measure: Baseline time and final error count

nodes.label: Prepare the evidence plan
nodes.guard: Freeze metrics before tuning; assign owner
nodes.failure: Synthetic-only mechanics if field trial unavailable

nodes.label: Set session policy
nodes.guard: No media processing before policy is active
nodes.failure: Block disallowed modality, keep manual path
nodes.measure: Pre-gate media/model calls must be zero

nodes.label: Join and establish roles
nodes.guard: Viewing link is not write authority
nodes.failure: Deny/rejoin; never infer identity from voice

nodes.label: Check devices and capacity
nodes.guard: Test target device before promising live latency
nodes.failure: Photo or typed fallback
nodes.measure: Startup failures and time to ready

nodes.label: Activate the session
nodes.output: Active policy version and capture lease
nodes.guard: All required participants covered; no pre-recorded agreement
nodes.failure: Pause at roster/policy changes
nodes.measure: Time to start and correctly blocked starts

nodes.label: Select photo or type a note
nodes.guard: Explicit intake action
nodes.failure: Retain draft locally only within policy

nodes.label: Inspect and redact locally
nodes.output: Approved input with sensitive areas removed
nodes.guard: Remove unwanted content before server/provider upload
nodes.failure: Retake or type selected notes

nodes.label: Prepare and bound input
nodes.guard: Byte/pixel limits before decode; preserve readable resolution
nodes.failure: Tile or crop instead of destructive downscale

nodes.label: Admit request
nodes.guard: Current scope, limits, request-payload identity
nodes.failure: Retry same request only after eligible failure

nodes.label: Persist source
nodes.guard: Content excluded from ordinary diagnostic logs
nodes.failure: Fail intake visibly; never acknowledge absent source

nodes.label: Assess capture quality
nodes.guard: Quality heuristics do not prove legibility
nodes.failure: Ask retake or manual region selection
nodes.measure: False quality rejects and unreadable regions

nodes.label: Segment notes
nodes.guard: No text inference before note boundaries checked
nodes.failure: Split/merge/add missing region

nodes.label: Review coverage
nodes.output: Corrected region set with stable IDs
nodes.guard: Show full image and unassigned areas, not only detected notes
nodes.failure: User adds missed note or marks occluded

nodes.label: Read each region
nodes.output: Text candidates indexed by region ID
nodes.guard: Validate returned IDs; retain unreadable state
nodes.failure: Manual transcription; bounded retry on failed crops only

nodes.label: Check words and spatial meaning
nodes.guard: Color/proximity are observations, not semantic agreement
nodes.failure: Keep original arrangement and unknown text

nodes.label: Create manual source
nodes.guard: Preserve authorship; validate size and content
nodes.failure: Inline validation and saved draft

nodes.label: Open permitted audio stream
nodes.guard: Policy current and device visible
nodes.failure: Stop and show gap

nodes.label: Detect speech and bound chunks
nodes.output: Chunks with overlap and clock metadata
nodes.guard: Backlog bounded; overlap not double counted
nodes.failure: Stop intake at capacity; explicit resume

nodes.label: Transcribe locally
nodes.guard: No third-party raw ASR; preserve uncertainty
nodes.failure: Smaller configured model or typed fallback

nodes.label: Reconcile timing and overlap
nodes.guard: Do not duplicate overlaps or assume shared clocks
nodes.failure: Mark gap/uncertain span instead of inventing continuity

nodes.label: Resolve speaker cautiously
nodes.guard: No loudest-device identity claim; confirmation not universal proof
nodes.failure: Keep unknown attribution

nodes.label: Correct the transcript
nodes.output: New source revision and dependency invalidation
nodes.guard: Retain origin; do not edit old revision in place
nodes.failure: Flag affected answers and minutes

nodes.label: Address the tool
nodes.output: Explicit request and selected item IDs
nodes.guard: Background meeting content cannot authorize actions
nodes.failure: Ask for explicit invocation

nodes.label: Freeze request context
nodes.guard: Selection belongs to actor and session
nodes.failure: Ask for selection if context ambiguous

nodes.label: Parse the operation
nodes.guard: Schema and operation allowlist
nodes.failure: Clarify once, then expose direct controls

nodes.label: Resolve references
nodes.guard: No silent guessing of those three
nodes.failure: User selects targets directly

nodes.label: Authorize and dispatch
nodes.output: Accepted proposal job or refused request
nodes.guard: Check current role again at eventual commit
nodes.failure: Refuse changed authority; refresh stale preview

nodes.label: Validate proposal envelope
nodes.guard: Source IDs and revisions exist in current session
nodes.failure: Reject malformed output; show recoverable failure

nodes.label: Prioritize review work
nodes.output: Review queue by consequence and age
nodes.guard: Do not rank only by model confidence
nodes.failure: Throttle new proposals when review overloaded
nodes.measure: Oldest review age and work abandoned

nodes.label: Inspect source and differences
nodes.guard: Text, grouping and placement are distinct decisions; planned F3.8 review exposes complete main points, supporting detail and evidence before Accept
nodes.failure: Edit, reject, or leave unresolved

nodes.label: Validate acceptance
nodes.input: Action, actor, source and item revisions
nodes.guard: No semantic auto-rebase after source/target change
nodes.failure: Refresh preview and ask again

nodes.label: Commit atomically
nodes.output: New item revision plus event plus result
nodes.guard: All-or-nothing local transaction
nodes.failure: Retry same key returns durable result

nodes.label: Synchronize views
nodes.guard: Detect sequence gaps; distinguish saved from pending; planned F3.8 disclosure and temporary offsets stay local to the viewing screen
nodes.failure: Resync snapshot then apply newer events
nodes.measure: Divergent client views and reconnect time

nodes.label: Edit or undo accepted work
nodes.guard: Do not erase a later edit by someone else
nodes.failure: Conflict preview with affected items
nodes.measure: Lost human work must be zero

nodes.label: Invalidate derived material
nodes.guard: Follow all source references transitively
nodes.failure: Mark unavailable before recomputation
nodes.measure: Stale outputs still represented as current

nodes.label: Organise incoming notes
nodes.input: Incoming main points or a team request, with current arrangements
nodes.output: Provisional organisation of incoming notes, or a requested rearrangement
nodes.guard: Planned F3.8: preserve accepted structure and team adjustments; conflicting regroupings require review, no idle whole-board reshuffling
nodes.failure: Keep current board

nodes.label: Choose representation
nodes.input: Task, item types and source structure
nodes.output: A fitting ordered set, spatial copy, cluster, timeline, matrix, flow or hierarchy
nodes.guard: Dates/axes must be meaningful; retain unplaced items
nodes.failure: Human form selector

nodes.label: Propose relationships
nodes.output: Source-linked main points, supporting detail, labelled topic/choice groups and identifiable relationship proposals
nodes.guard: Planned F3.8: preserve qualifications; invent neither background nor causality from proximity or colour; original photo colour is evidence, not automatic topic colour
nodes.failure: Keep uncertain relationships separate

nodes.label: Lay out deterministically
nodes.input: Validated structure, collapsed main points and saved anchors
nodes.output: Saved overview geometry and stable group-to-colour mapping; local expansion uses temporary spacing
nodes.guard: Expansion never writes positions or accepts meaning; preserve fixed-axis markers and team adjustments; topic fills have labels and a key, preserve team colour overrides and never encode review state
nodes.failure: Place in new area or explain lack of space

nodes.label: Review arrangement separately
nodes.guard: Layout acceptance does not accept child claims
nodes.failure: Edit structure or return to original

nodes.label: Build fresh source indexes
nodes.guard: Deleted/stale sources excluded
nodes.failure: Search raw approved text or show limited coverage

nodes.label: Understand question
nodes.guard: Question scope limited to available session evidence
nodes.failure: Clarify entity/time; do not invent referent

nodes.label: Retrieve support and disagreement
nodes.guard: Coverage watermark carried forward
nodes.failure: Show nearest moments with limitation

nodes.label: Draft answer claims
nodes.guard: No names beyond supported speaker identity
nodes.failure: Extractive answer or abstention

nodes.label: Check support before release
nodes.guard: Valid citation IDs alone do not prove entailment
nodes.failure: Omit unsupported clause; hold unchecked stream

nodes.label: Present answer with coverage
nodes.guard: No unchecked tokens displayed as settled answer
nodes.failure: Show evidence only or refusal
nodes.measure: Wrong answer acceptance and retrieval time

nodes.label: Identify topic episode
nodes.guard: Silence is not agreement or irreversible closure
nodes.failure: Manual agenda boundary; reopen episode

nodes.label: Extract candidates
nodes.guard: Owner/deadline absent unless supported
nodes.failure: Leave blanks and explicit unresolved status

nodes.label: Classify decision status
nodes.guard: Human confirmation required for confirmed decision
nodes.failure: Present unresolved disagreement

nodes.label: Link evolving decisions
nodes.guard: Never overwrite a prior decision without trace
nodes.failure: Keep conflicting versions for review

nodes.label: Choose output and coverage
nodes.guard: No promise of unavailable minutes/board provider
nodes.failure: Offer supported local artifact

nodes.label: Resolve review and redaction
nodes.guard: Names-only replacement cannot scrub free text/images
nodes.failure: Exclude sensitive source and explain omissions

nodes.label: Freeze export manifest
nodes.guard: Late edits require a new snapshot; planned F3.8 exports explicitly distinguish overview from complete detail, independently of open notes
nodes.failure: Notify export is older than current canvas

nodes.label: Render and verify artifact
nodes.guard: No provisional-to-confirmed promotion in rendering
nodes.failure: Fail with artifact-specific error

nodes.label: Deliver local export
nodes.guard: Check role/policy at delivery; cancel after deletion
nodes.failure: Retry retrieval of same artifact

nodes.label: Prepare external board operations
nodes.output: Per-item operation journal and target mapping
nodes.guard: Provider access and update semantics verified first
nodes.failure: Use local export

nodes.label: Reconcile partial board push
nodes.output: Confirmed mappings or unknown outcome list
nodes.guard: Do not blindly retry unknown successful creation
nodes.failure: Read back by stable marker or ask user

nodes.label: Complete release receipt
nodes.output: Version, destination and control boundary record
nodes.guard: Never promise recall of downloaded copies
nodes.failure: Mark partial delivery and remaining actions

nodes.label: Pause on stop or roster change
nodes.input: Any stop request or changed agreement
nodes.output: New policy version and immediate capture pause
nodes.guard: No facilitator approval required to pause
nodes.failure: Close local device even if server is unreachable

nodes.label: Cancel and reject late work
nodes.input: Revoked policy version and queued jobs
nodes.output: Cancelled attempts and rejected late commits
nodes.guard: Every write checks current policy/tombstone
nodes.failure: Quarantine late output for purge, never publish

nodes.label: Resume or close deliberately
nodes.output: New capture lease or closed session
nodes.guard: Resume is explicit and rechecks full roster
nodes.failure: Stay paused; manual permitted actions only

nodes.label: Detect expiry and purge request
nodes.input: Close, lease expiry or deletion request
nodes.guard: Content unavailable before asynchronous purge
nodes.failure: Retry failed store deletion; show pending

nodes.label: Erase content and derivatives
nodes.guard: Include job payloads, event bodies, indexes, caches and owned exports
nodes.failure: Escalate unconfirmed store; do not label deleted

nodes.label: Confirm deletion boundary
nodes.output: Content-free receipt or explicit partial state
nodes.guard: Receipt contains no reconstructable source content
nodes.failure: Visible failure and bounded retries

nodes.label: Recover after crash or restore
nodes.output: Resumed eligible jobs and valid state
nodes.guard: Apply deletion rules before any restored read
nodes.failure: Keep unavailable while reconciliation runs

nodes.label: Observe process cost
nodes.guard: Separate waiting, machine and human time
nodes.failure: Record unknowns instead of fake zeros

nodes.label: Score held-out results
nodes.guard: No tuning on the held-out wall/session
nodes.failure: Expand dataset or narrow supported conditions

nodes.label: Compare process variants
nodes.guard: Change one major factor; retain all failed trials
nodes.failure: Keep simpler variant when inconclusive

nodes.label: Record next decision
nodes.guard: Document negative results and remaining uncertainty
nodes.failure: Repeat targeted test, not full feature expansion
